texts:
Sunday rearranged three backfields.

Woody Marks took over in Houston.

Samaje Perine led Cincinnati in carries.

Philadelphia finished London with its fourth back.

Here is what's still good from Week 5.

Let's get into it.
#HTownMade #WhoDey #FlyEaglesFly

David Montgomery left at TEN with a groin injury and may miss some time. RB21 rest of season for me; monitor Wednesday's report.

Woody Marks played 47 of 48 snaps after that, 19 touches. Claim him, 10 to 20 percent of FAAB.
#HTownMade #TitanUp

Marvin Harrison Jr. was traded to Houston, where Nico Collins is the top target. WR43 rest of season for me; hold him.

Tyjae Spears topped half of Tennessee's snaps for the first time and caught 9. Add him in PPR, 1 to 3 percent.
#HTownMade #TitanUp

Samaje Perine ran 14 times for 68 and caught a TD at MIA. Stash him over the bye, 1 to 3 percent.

Chase Brown out-snapped him 38 to 33 but ran 13 for 39 and lost a fumble. RB6 rest of season for me; hold him.
#WhoDey #PhinsUp

Ja'Marr Chase was back from the concussion: 10 targets, 6 for 77 and a TD. WR1 rest of season for me.

Ollie Gordon II ran 18 times for 88 and a TD on 43 snaps, with Achane on IR. Claim him during the bye, 5 to 10 percent.
#WhoDey #PhinsUp

Saquon Barkley sat in London. RB8 rest of season for me; monitor Wednesday's practice report.

Will Shipley scored, then hurt his foot. Monitor Wednesday.

Dameon Pierce ran 11 times for 14. A claim only if Barkley misses Wednesday too.
#FlyEaglesFly

Parker Washington led Jacksonville with 9 targets, 6 for 124 and 2 TDs. Trade for him; offer a WR3 and a bench RB.

Bhayshul Tuten ran a career-high 22 times for 72 and took 87.5 percent of the early downs. RB18 rest of season for me; hold him.
#DUUUVAL

Thursday night first.

Bucky Irving ran 21 times for 165 and scored twice at DAL, and got the first two goal-line snaps. RB17 rest of season for me; hold him.

George Pickens caught 9 of 13 for 130 and a TD. WR10 rest of season for me.
#GoBucs #DallasCowboys

Jahmyr Gibbs ran 25 times for 151 and 2 TDs @ARI. RB1 rest of season for me.

Jeremiyah Love ran 12 times for 22 with 1 target while Arizona chased. RB15 rest of season for me; hold him, the early downs are still his.
#OnePride #BirdGang

D'Andre Swift played 40 of the first 56 snaps at GB with Kyle Monangai out, and scored. RB13 rest of season for me; hold him.

MarShawn Lloyd scored twice and out-snapped Pierre Strong 26 to 24, with Chris Brooks on IR. Add Lloyd, 3 to 6 percent.
#DaBears #GoPackGo

Braelon Allen ran 24 times for 116 and a TD with Breece Hall out again. Hold Allen while Hall sits.

Quinshon Judkins was seen in a walking boot after 14 carries for 44. RB20 rest of season for me; monitor his foot tests this week.
#JetUp #DawgPound

Jaylen Warren ran for 101 and caught 6 for 87, with Rico Dowdle out a third week. RB23 rest of season for me; hold him until Dowdle is back.

Germie Bernard was the every-down receiver, 6 for 80. Add him in deep leagues, 0 to 2 percent.
#HereWeGo

Pat Freiermuth scored twice on 5 catches for 44. Touchdowns on five catches do not repeat. TE27 rest of season for me; drop him for any add on the list.

Tyler Warren caught 7 for 83 and ran one in. TE3 rest of season for me.
#HereWeGo #ForTheShoe

TreVeyon Henderson hurt his ankle early vs LV. RB26 rest of season for me; monitor Wednesday's report.

Rhamondre Stevenson ran 13 times for 64 and a TD. RB24 rest of season for me; hold him.
#NEPats #RaiderNation

Ashton Jeanty played 27 percent of Las Vegas' third downs, down from 70 percent in Weeks 1 to 4, while playing through the ankle. RB8 rest of season for me; hold him.

Brock Bowers caught 8 for 110 and a TD. TE1 rest of season for me.
#RaiderNation #NEPats

Aaron Jones Sr. played 87 percent of the snaps at NO and ran 25 times for 113 and a TD. Trade for him over the bye; offer a bench RB.

Alvin Kamara played 5 snaps through three quarters. RB45 rest of season for me; monitor Wednesday's report on the back.
#Skol #Saints

Isaiah Likely caught 11 of 13 for 94 and 2 TDs in the tie at WAS. TE11 rest of season for me; hold him.

Jayden Daniels ran 9 times for 103 and 2 TDs in his first game back. Trade for him in superflex; offer a WR3.
#NYGiants #RaiseHail

Mike Evans played through broken ribs @SEA: 10 targets, 7 for 113 and a TD. Trade for him; offer a WR3.

Deebo Samuel Sr. hurt his hamstring. WR39 rest of season for me; monitor the MRI.
#FTTB #Seahawks

J.K. Dobbins ran 18 times for 68 and a TD at LAC. RJ Harvey had 3 carries and no catches. Hold Dobbins over Harvey.

Omarion Hampton ran 14 times for 33 in a three-way split. RB14 rest of season for me; hold him, the price is at its lowest.
#BroncosCountry #BoltUp

Lamar Jackson sat, and Tyler Huntley won it in overtime at ATL with 2 TDs and a sneak. Jackson has a real chance for Week 6; monitor Wednesday.

Michael Penix Jr. hurt his ribs and says it is not long term. Monitor his imaging.
#RavensFlock #DirtyBirds

Real.

Drake Maye threw for 374 and 4 TDs and ran one in, a week after 54 rushing yards. Trade for him; offer a WR3.

Christian Watson caught 6 of 8 for 143 and 2 TDs. WR18 rest of season for me; trade for him, offer a WR3.
#NEPats #GoPackGo

Noise.

Jonathan Taylor still had 15 carries to Seth McGowan's 5. RB3 rest of season for me; hold him.

Cam Skattebo lost his fourth fumble in five games but played 56 snaps. RB19 rest of season for me; hold him.
#ForTheShoe #NYGiants

The misses.

Bucky Irving was RB20 for me; he ran for 165.

Ollie Gordon II was RB28; he ran for 88 and a TD.

Jeremiyah Love was RB13; he ran 12 for 22.

Tyler Shough was QB13; he threw for 96 and 2 picks.
#GoBucs #PhinsUp #BirdGang #Saints

Every takeaway, usage note and overreaction from Week 5 is on the site, with Monday night going into Tuesday's waiver run.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the rest of the week's calls, and repost this for your league.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/leftovers.html?week=5
